name: io.github.rchurro/kasm-use
title: kasm-use
description: Computer-use for Kasm Workspaces: lets AI agents see and drive your Kasm desktops over KasmVNC.

environmentVariables.name: KASM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Kasm API key (see README for the five permissions it needs)

environmentVariables.name: KASM_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Kasm user the agent's sessions are created for

environmentVariables.name: KASM_VERIFY_TLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to false for a self-signed Kasm certificate
